correctness.rationale: Rebuilt all convex octagon disjoint-endpoint noncrossing matchings: 28/140/140/14 faces. First barycentric flags give C8 quotient cells [45,169,168,42] and D8 [35,112,105,27], with rank-increasing chains ensuring no inversions. Independently implemented signed integer differential and unit-pivot contractions, obtaining C8 cancellations (44,124,42), residual [1,1,2,0] and surviving degree-2 row entries 4 and 2 with gcd2; hence H1=Z2, H2=Z. D8 cancellations (34,78,27) leave a point. The inspected independent edge-presentation Tietze procedure reduces C8 to one generator with g^2 relators and D8 to empty group; simple connectivity and acyclicity imply D8 contractible. UCT gives H1(Z)=0 and H2(Z)=Z+Z2; integral Bockstein on nonzero H1(F2) injects into the order-2 class, reduction is nonzero, so Sq1(alpha)=alpha^2 !=0. Finite n4..7 census is exhaustive only for stated lower cutoff.
